notes: PROVISIONAL defaults pending a calibration pilot (docs/regime.md).
No model default: the runner refuses to launch without --model.
instances null = the 5 shipped worlds: orion-holdings, vega-group, lyra-partners, cygnus-holdings, perseus-portfolio. 5 worlds x 6 arms x 8 reps = 240 cells, the pre-registered design.

max_turns is the primary budget: pin iterations and record cost as an outcome (v7 Appendix A entries 14 and 23). 40 turns is set generously so that it is not the binding constraint, and the 3600 s clock sits above the paper's 1500 s clock. wall_clock_s and usd_rail are rails: a trial that hits one is scored (no deliverable = fail) and never retried.

The paper ran eval 2 on a dollar budget ($3, --max-budget-usd) with a 1500 s timeout; a dollar budget and a clock bind differently per model (v7 entry 14), so new runs pin turns instead and are a new series.
query_budget: the paper enforced no readonly budget (E23-D6); v1 enforces 3 world_query calls server-side and the readonly prompt states it.
